description: Defines abstract classes for user-defined stateful stream processing in Apache Spark Structured Streaming, including handling of input rows, timers, and initial state.

classes.name: StatefulProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class for user-defined stateful processing logic on keyed streams, including lifecycle methods and handle management.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorWithInitialState
classes.description: Extension of StatefulProcessor supporting initial state for starting streaming queries with pre-existing state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the processor with output and time modes.

methods.name: handleInputRows
methods.description: Processes input rows for a given key, possibly producing output rows.

methods.name: handleExpiredTimer
methods.description: Handles timer expiration events, can evict state, register timers, and produce output.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations at the end of processing.

methods.name: setHandle
methods.description: Sets the handle used to interact with the state store.

methods.name: getHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle for interacting with the state store, throws error if not initialized.

methods.name: handleInitialState
methods.description: Processes initial state during the first batch for starting streaming with existing state.
